implementation.painting: Own Core Image pipeline: bounded decode, lower-cover colour quantization, gradient-masked Gaussian blur and colour compositing; fixed screen backdrop with scroll-driven cover transform. Prefer a text-free TMDB portrait behind the independent wordmark.
limits: Original source code and full paint shader parameters are unavailable.
Background colour extraction and blur curves are independent implementations, not recovered original algorithms.
Only the real TMDB rating is displayed.
implementation.video: Native AVQueuePlayer + AVPlayerLooper + AVPlayerLayer, aspect fill, muted, no controller or WebView. Public IMDb trailer catalog supplies expiring MP4 URLs. Player pauses and is removed when the hero leaves the screen.
implementation.performance: Native UICollectionView paging with stable UIHostingConfiguration cells, UIPageControl, drag-progress background crossfade; hero state isolated from catalog rails; bounded prefetch and processed-image cache. Enabled CADisableMinimumFrameDurationOnPhone, also present in the reference IPA.

verification.devicePlayback: Native AVPlayer time advanced to 7.0 s on iPhone; no WebView
verification.simulator: iPhone 17 Pro Max / iOS 26.5; native pagination and movie/series detail flows passed
verification.frameRate: High-refresh capability enabled; actual ProMotion frame pacing is not measured by Simulator.
